label: Single Expand
description: A basic single-expand accordion. Best for the minimal pattern: 3 questions with one answer open at a time and the first open on load.

label: Plus Minus Icons
description: Accordion with plus/minus indicators. Best for feature summaries that can all stay open at once, each row ending in a plus that flips to a minus.

label: Bordered Rounded
description: Accordion with borders and rounded corners. Best for each question boxed on its own with a gap between, holding long answers in muted text, one open at a time.

label: In Card
description: Accordion embedded within a Card. Best for plan, billing and security questions under a titled Card header that can open together, the first ending in a View plans button.

label: Disabled Items
description: Accordion with a disabled item and an open tint. Best for one outlined box whose open row takes a muted tint, with a locked middle row that cannot be opened.

label: Icons & Badges
description: Accordion with icons and badges. Best for spaced card rows led by an icon tile, one open at a time, with a New badge and the answer indented under the label.

label: In Frame
description: Accordion in a framed list. Best for settings rows with icon tiles joined in one outlined box, where each section opens without closing the others.

label: Nested
description: Nested accordion example with bordered items. Best for a product details list where one section opens onto its own inner set of sub sections, both levels open on load.

label: User List
description: User list accordion with avatars and role indicators. Best for team members shown by avatar, name and role badge, each opening to a summary of what they may access.

label: Rotating Arrow
description: Accordion with a turning chevron. Best for a chevron ahead of each question that turns to point down when open, with the answer indented under the text.

label: Setup Steps
description: Setup steps accordion with icons, badges and a QR code. Best for a 3 step setup checklist with done, in progress and pending states, the open step holding an email field.
